tvShow.overview: A zany nobleman contends with family feuds and clashes with peasants in his quest to become the most famous person in Poland.

episodes.name: The Assembly
episodes.overview: Upon receiving an invitation to a nobleman's assembly, patriarch Jan Paweł seeks his son's advice on asserting dominance over his archnemesis, Andrzej.

episodes.name: The Estate
episodes.overview: Aniela takes action against climate change but faces pushback. A curiously familiar figure among the peasants catches Jakub's attention.

episodes.name: Spring
episodes.overview: As their refined, prospective in-laws visit, Jan Paweł finds it challenging to take charge while Zofia wrestles with unfamiliar emotions.

episodes.name: Equality March
episodes.overview: In Stanisław's absence, Jakub hatches an inheritance plot to oust Aniela while Jan Paweł wrestles with a decision about an upcoming march for equality.

episodes.name: The Plague
episodes.overview: A traveling theater group wreaks havoc on the village but arouses Maciej's curiosity as he faces romantic defeat. Bogdan seems to find his calling.

episodes.name: The Duel
episodes.overview: Aniela investigates her mother's suspicious mood shift, seemingly sparked by mysterious letters. Jan Paweł scrambles to get out of a sticky situation.

episodes.name: The Hunt
episodes.overview: Jakub goes on a business trip while Jan Paweł partakes in a hunting contest against Andrzej to win over a wealthy bon vivant looking for a wife.

episodes.name: The Wedding
episodes.overview: Wedding festivities take a backseat when an ominous investigator's persistence forces bitter rivals Jan Paweł and Andrzej to collaborate.

guest_stars.character: Peasant with a Knife in His Back
guest_stars.name: Maciej Buchwald

episodes.name: The Al-Inklusiv
episodes.overview: To strengthen ties with Leszek while on a family vacation, Jan Paweł offers to translate political negotiations — despite not knowing a lick of Turkish.

episodes.name: The Funeral
episodes.overview: With plans in place for a lavish funeral and a wild-boar banquet, arrangements go awry when the boar makes plans of its own.

episodes.name: A Quick Bet
episodes.overview: A visit from the Royal Marshal Office complicates Aniela's love life while Jan Paweł turns to gambling to solve his financial troubles.

episodes.name: The Ball Game
episodes.overview: Jan Paweł hosts a traditional ball game to prove to Bogdan that his peasants are worth investing in. Aniela discovers the power of a mustache.

episodes.name: Witchcraft
episodes.overview: While searching for Andrzej's daughters in the woods, Jan Paweł finds himself lured in by a wood nymph. Zofia seeks out a local witch for some advice.

episodes.name: Kupala Night
episodes.overview: Arranged marriage is in the air during midsummer as Bogdan must choose a bride. Problem is, Stanisław also has an interest in one of the candidates.

episodes.name: Krakow
episodes.overview: Aniela embarks on a quest to save Maciej from his salty fate. Bogdan's stag trip turns into a night of unadulterated debauchery and unexpected murder.

episodes.name: The Harvest Festival
episodes.overview: Jan Paweł uses the festivities of the harvest to enter the race for community leader, but his aspirations are overshadowed by an unforeseen opponent.

episodes.name: Sarmatian Exam
episodes.overview: Eight months after the fateful harvest festival, Aniela returns to Adamczycha only to find the village in shambles and her parents down in the dumps.

episodes.name: The Last Aurochs
episodes.overview: When Jan Paweł learns that a heroic deed can restore his nobility, he sets out to find an extinct animal. Maciej tries to escape his unexpected captor.

episodes.name: Yurodivy
episodes.overview: A trip to Warsaw for an audience with the king leaves Jan Paweł in competition with a soothsayer while Aniela deals with an awkward encounter.

episodes.name: Luna
episodes.overview: Jakub attempts to sabotage Aniela's plans to open a school for peasants. Jan Paweł's next scheme to win back his nobility turns into a real moon shot.

episodes.name: A Gift For The Tatars
episodes.overview: Another visit to the royal court brings back a familiar face from beyond the grave. Andrzej calls on Zofia for help with raising his daughters

episodes.name: Virgo
episodes.overview: During her first class, Aniela ends up teaching her students more than she anticipated. A horoscope puts Jan Paweł in touch with his feminine side.

episodes.name: Flauto Traverso
episodes.overview: Jan Paweł's plan to get back in Zofia's good graces backfires in every possible way. Meanwhile, Maciej has a short-lived reunion with Aniela.

episodes.name: Rise of the Machines
episodes.overview: The royal couple decides to visit Adamczycha right when a peasant uprising kicks off, leaving the fate of the village in the unfit hands of Jan Paweł.
